hooks.command: h=.claude/hooks/pre-bash-destructive.sh; d=$(pwd -P); while :; do [ -x "$d/$h" ] && exec "$d/$h"; [ "$d" = / ] && break; d=$(dirname "$d"); done; [ -n "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" ] && [ -x "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/$h" ] && exec "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/$h"; echo "BLOCKED: $h not found above the working directory or in CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR. The safety check did not run." >&2; exit 2
